subject: Film & Cinema
title: Motion Capture: Acting in Digital Skin
description: Learn Motion Capture: Acting in Digital Skin in one minute.

hook.text: Andy Serkis performed Gollum in a grey suit with dots on his face. The world saw a digital creature.

buildup.text: Motion capture records an actor's movements and maps them onto a digital character.

discovery.text: Planet of the Apes and Avatar pushed mocap to the point where the performance feels fully alive.

twist.text: The Oscars refuse to nominate mocap performances — is it acting or animation? The debate rages.

climax.text: Motion capture blurs the boundary between actor and animated character forever.

punchline.text: The actor disappears. The performance remains.

quiz.question: Why is Andy Serkis significant in motion capture history?
options: His performance as Gollum proved mocap could deliver nuanced acting
